name: BanglaLem-bench
description: BanglaLem-bench evaluates lemmatization performance for Bangla by measuring how well models map inflected Bangla surface forms to their canonical lemmas. It focuses on morphological normalization across diverse word forms and contexts in Bangla text. The benchmark is designed for evaluating token-level sequence mapping or sequence-to-sequence lemmatization systems.
reputation: A niche, language-specific benchmark used primarily by researchers working on Bengali NLP and morphology with limited broad adoption.
